name: Alma
source: A young man who belongs to the Shichou race. He seeked Aliceforte's help when his master was in trouble. With his beautiful appearance and arrogant attitude, he's quite a troublemaker who's not very aware of his surroundings. He despises Ciel, even though they're the same race.
